በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ገባር: ገባር — workman, labourer (noun; agent noun of ገብረ)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
ቅድሜሁ: ቅድመ — before him (preposition ቅድመ in its form ቅድሜ- + -hu 'him')
ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
እከውን: ኮነ — I will become, be (imperf. 1s, k-w-n)
ለዓለም: ዓለም — for ever (ለ- 'to, for' + noun 'age, world, eternity')
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
በከመ: ከመ — according as, just as (በ- + ከመ, conjunction)
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ለእጓለ: እጓል — to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
ዘተፈጥረ: ተፈጥረ — which was created (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ፈጠረ)
ወለእመኒ: ለእመ — and even if (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ 'if' + enclitic -ኒ 'even')
ገብረ: ገብር — servant, slave (noun; accusative predicate in -a, after ኩን)
የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom')
ሎቱ: ለ — to him, for him (preposition ለ- with 3m sg suffix -tu: ሎቱ)
ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
ዓምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct; variant spelling ዓምላከ)
ለክሙ: ለ — to you, for you (preposition ለ- with 2mp suffix -ክሙ)
ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
ጽላተ: ጽላት — tablets of (noun, plural; construct before ዘኪዳን)
በእደ: እድ — by the hand of (በ- + noun, construct; plural stem አእዳው)
